info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Product Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Special Pricing Conditions Retrieval API allows consumers to access specific pricing conditions related to banking products by providing a unique parameter. This endpoint is essential for businesses looking to manage their product offerings efficiently, offering insights into special pricing strategies. Typical users include financial analysts, product managers, and developers integrating pricing mechanisms into applications. By leveraging this API, organizations can ensure they provide the best possible pricing options to their customers, aligned with their business strategies.

get.summary: Retrieve special pricing condition by ID
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific special pricing condition using its unique identifier. It is essential for managing and reviewing pricing strategies effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve special pricing conditions for a specific product identified by its unique resource identifier. The request should contain the necessary parameters to accurately fetch the related pricing conditions.

200.description: Successful retrieval of special pricing conditions.

GetProductManagementByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation to retrieve special pricing conditions. The body is expected to be a string that may contain specific parameters or identifiers related to the operation.
